# LabeledPhotoCard

A photo tile with a label laid over it: a category, a cuisine, a party cover.

`NomNom.LabeledPhotoCard` · Content

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.LabeledPhotoCard label="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="NomNom.LabeledPhotoCard" label="…"></x-import>
```

## Notes

A photo tile with a scrim label: a category, a cuisine, a cover.
